blocks.goal: Remove the direct dependency from org.apache.commons.io.function.IOStream to org.apache.commons.io.IOExceptionList by moving the small utility checkEmpty() logic into IOStream so IOStream no longer calls IOExceptionList.

ops.details: Move the implementation of IOExceptionList.checkEmpty() into org.apache.commons.io.function.IOStream as a private static helper method (IOStream.checkEmpty()). Keep the same semantics and signature shape except make it private/static as appropriate for internal use by IOStream. Remove the moved method implementation from IOExceptionList.
Update the call site(s) inside IOStream to invoke the new internal method IOStream.checkEmpty() instead of org.apache.commons.io.IOExceptionList.checkEmpty().
Remove unused import of org.apache.commons.io.IOExceptionList from IOStream if present. Ensure IOStream compiles with its new internal method and no longer imports IOExceptionList.
